subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `previewStreamingSessionOverride` as a permanent shared channel-plugin capability with a persisted `/stream` session command across Telegram, Discord, and Slack?
rationale: This choice defines a cross-plugin API and persistent user-facing command contract; source review can verify implementation mechanics but cannot decide whether this should become the supported long-term product surface.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Confirm the capability and persistent session override as the intended cross-channel API, then require current-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to an owner plugin
options.body: Keep the behavior in a single approved channel plugin until a broader shared contract is deliberately designed.

options.title: Decline the command surface
options.body: Close the feature direction if per-session streaming controls should remain configuration-only.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the capability and persistent session override as the intended cross-channel API, then require current-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the intended feature boundary and supply the requested current-head proof, while a repository decision-maker must sponsor the permanent API direction.
